launches.title: Parley - Making immigration simple
launches.tagline: We help immigration firms write visa applications with AI, starting with the O-1A Writer.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** Parley helps immigration lawyers write visa applications using AI. We integrate directly into a lawyer’s typical workflow so they can start writing with Parley from day 1 and deliver results to their clients faster.\
—

Hi everyone, we’re Jackson, Philip, and Ian, and we’re the co-founders of [Parley](http://www.parley.so).

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdt6N9Q8vNdjiG9xxDpkQcK7DC6o2oJ1pXc5CeFeNpU2jR8qqIb_HbbsvKCgbOuoHmlHJKSF1Y3cnlKz0SCU2BWfICIW3sVsxtv2MV5POsxXUBkkqgYH2Rzq1YRLdcm9rTZf4rLxt6pCFzt6-DOYN-A2yKY?key=bRVaeO2Jsn5Nds8A8Ue9KA)

**📚 The Problem**

It’s no secret that the immigration system in the U.S. is broken. Anyone pursuing a work or immigrant visa will tell you about the difficulties of lottery systems, exorbitant fees, and endless paperwork. 

At Parley, we believe an important piece to fixing this process is **automating work for immigration firms.** For some visa types, a lawyer or legal writer spends several days writing a single application, learning about the most complex and technical professions, collating hundreds of pages of evidence, and synthesizing it all into a cohesive petition. Meanwhile, an applicant eagerly waits for their opportunity. By helping lawyers work better on a daily basis, we hope to accelerate Parley’s speed to impact — reducing the complexity of immigration.

**✍️ The Solution** 

Parley makes immigration processes easier. Our first product, the O-1A Writer, helps **immigration attorneys speed write a petition** while keeping them in the loop. As a lawyer does the critical thinking in specifying what argument they want to make, our writer dynamically pulls content from an applicant's evidence, fits that material to the context of the application, and automatically drafts a petition for review. We do this all directly in Microsoft Word — where most attorneys spend their time writing. We’re quickly expanding support for more visa types like the H-1B, TN, EB-1, EB-2 NIW, L-1, and more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81798&key=user_uploads/410497/9ed0f8d6-b11f-48a8-acc1-3a6d50fb74df)

**Asks:** 

* Want to use the product? **Book a demo **[**here**](https://calendly.com/philip-parley/15min)**.**
* **Been through a visa process?** Reach out to us and tell us about your journey at [founders@parley.so](mailto:founders@parley.so) - we’d love to talk!
* **Like what we’re building?** Share this post! Spread the word to help us build toward the vision of making immigration simple.

launches.title: Gale - Fast and Data-Driven Business Immigration
launches.body:
Gale is a tech platform that automates the entire H-1B application and compliance process for US employers, with independent licensed attorneys ensuring accuracy at all steps.

https://youtu.be/tmMnGLIa3fs

### **The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88070&key=user_uploads/1751117/82978c7b-fae9-48b4-8b08-a909d1852a7c)

_An email from a founder in W25 to their immigration law firm (name redacted to protect the guilty)_

We’ve talked to enough employers to know dealing with immigration sucks. Here’s why:

* Slow response times from lawyers (1-3 business days at least)
* No help on complex compliance requirements after visa approval
* Knowledge transfer and communication done via email or janky web forms
* Confusing questionnaires or document checklists

### **The Solution**

We help US employers spend as little time as possible worrying about H-1Bs and how to be compliant. Here’s how:

* Fast online data intake process with AI-powered document intake that auto-fills your application
* Easy to follow tooltips and comprehensive FAQ 
* Automated H-1B compliance for you and your team even after H-1B approval
* An **experienced immigration lawyer** handles and reviews each individual case with the same level of scrutiny as a law firm
* Fast turnaround time for legal questions
* We use english, no legal jargon

### **Moving forward**

H-1Bs are just the beginning. We’ve already started working on expanding our offering to help both consumers and businesses with other types of visas such as O-1s, Fs, Ks and TNs. The US immigration service market isn’t built for the 21st century, and we believe by using a mix of AI and professionals in the loop we can change that.

### **Our Ask**

**Know someone who is hiring or has hired H-1B workers?** Whether it’s a startup, SMB, enterprise, university, or nonprofit, we’d love an introduction! You can email us at [**rahul@getgale.app**](mailto:rahul@getgale.app).

We’d also appreciate it if you could share this post, or our demo video and follow us on [**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/galeapp) to stay updated on our journey!

### **Team**

Rahul (CEO), Rishabh (CTO), and Haokun (CPO) have been building together since middle school and later studied at the University of Waterloo. After working at companies like NVIDIA and Tesla, they experienced the inefficiencies of the immigration process firsthand and decided to automate it.
